verdict.rationale: Firecrawl is a web data API that runs jobs such as crawls, agent tasks and monitor checks, so versioning and rolling back automation configurations is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack never mentions version history, review workflows or rollback for any job or monitor configuration. Webhooks, audit events and API-key controls are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
